product.name: Printable Gift Tag Kit
product.description: Print-ready gift tag sheets — 24 Christmas designs and 12 all-year designs, 10 tags per sheet in US Letter (4.25 x 2.2 in) and A4 (105 x 59.4 mm), pale cut lines on the inside guides, a 9 mm safe border, write-on To/From lines and a punch circle, plus a read-me with print settings and the five cuts. No Canva plan needed. (Genius Junkie)
product.note: NEW PACK — printable PDFs only, no Canva template, so no CANVA_LINK step. Free rung = names CSV + cutting guide (built new).
